policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a procedural guidance page for the online submission portal for AI operators to request confirmation of whether their AI qualifies as 'high-impact AI' (고영향 인공지능) under Article 33 of South Korea's AI Basic Act. The page instructs operators to self-assess first using the judgment guideline before submitting a formal request. It references a helpdesk (aiact@sw.or.kr) that provides guidance but not direct determination. No explicit penalties or enforcement actions are described on this page.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document establishes a portal for AI businesses to confirm whether their AI qualifies as 'high-impact AI' under South Korea's AI Basic Act, emphasizing compliance and safety classification of AI systems that could significantly affect people. The framing centers on protecting the public from high-impact AI while supporting businesses with self-assessment guidelines.
